name: ajvc
identity_check: ajvc (styled lowercase; also AJVC / A Junior VC) at ajuniorvc.com: a SEBI-regulated pre-seed fund investing in India, founded in 2024 by Aviral Bhatnagar (ex-Venture Highway). Its fund vehicle is AJVC Trust. Confirmed by domain, the site's own description and press naming Bhatnagar as founder. Not Venture Highway (his earlier Delhi NCR firm) and not Novastar Partners (an LP in ajvc).

thesis_text.value: Pre-seed fund backing Indian founders from idea or prototype stage, offering standard terms of ₹1.5 Cr for 9% equity. Open to any sector; press coverage cites AI, SaaS, consumer tech, consumer brands and B2B. Positions itself as India's most approachable pre-seed investor: yes/no within 48 hours, decision within about three weeks, plus an ongoing founder-support program.
